qualifications.decision: Different setting types: enterprise pattern overrides versus inherited delegated bypass. Retain both, not a manufactured contradiction or universal hierarchy rule.
Unknown is not inactive, and inactive is not proof that no unauthorized access occurred.
Historical enterprise default option and current-source creation/transfer/failure distinctions do not certify successful deployment or complete estate coverage.
Read-only repository analysis and separate enabled-service pull-request creation are different operations, not a promise of mutation-free feature enablement.
